auth.tagline: Biomagnetic Pair practice, documented with care.
auth.signInSub: Use your clinic account. Sessions end after 15 minutes of inactivity.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended after a period of inactivity. Please sign in again.
auth.invalid: The email or password is not correct.
auth.invalidCode: That code is not valid or was already used. Try the next code from your app.
auth.mfaSub: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.totpHint: 6 digits — the code refreshes every 30 seconds.
auth.recoveryHint: One of the 10 codes you saved when you set up two-step verification (xxxxx-xxxxx). Each works once.
auth.changeSub: Welcome, {name}. Your administrator set a temporary password — choose your own before continuing.
auth.tempPasswordHint: The temporary password you received from your administrator.

pw.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well — avoid your name, email or common passwords.
pw.common: This password is too common or too simple.

setup.title: Welcome to YOU HEAL Clinical
setup.sub: Let’s set up your clinic. This takes about a minute and only happens once.
setup.orgNameHint: Shown on reports and printed documents. You can change it later.
setup.adminSub: This account manages {org}: users, clinic profile and the audit log.
setup.doneSub: Sign in with the administrator account you just created.
setup.mfaNext: Administrators must protect their account with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password). You will be guided right after signing in.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the server log at first start and stored in the data folder as setup-token.

mfa.title: Set up two-step verification
mfa.sub: Protect your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app.
mfa.requiredAdmin: Administrators must enable two-step verification before using the clinic. It takes about a minute.
mfa.step1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the setup key below.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.qrUnavailable: QR code unavailable — use the setup key.
mfa.recoverySub: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once.
mfa.recoveryWarn: These codes are shown only now. Print them or store them in your password manager — not on this computer’s desktop.
mfa.savedAck: I have saved my recovery codes in a safe place.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.body: For patient privacy you will be signed out in

patients.title: Patients

patients.searchPlaceholder: Exact last name or MRN, e.g. González or YH-000123
patients.searchHint: For privacy, names are matched exactly (not partially). Accents and capitals don’t matter.
patients.byLetter: Browse by first letter of the last name

count_letter.one: 1 patient with last name starting with {q}
count_letter.other: {count} patients with last names starting with {q}

patients.emptyBody: Add the first patient to start an intake and a scan.
patients.noMatchBody: Check the spelling of the full last name, try the MRN or date of birth, or browse by letter.

patient.name: Patient
patient.mrnHint: Leave blank to assign the next clinic number automatically (YH-000001…).
patient.mrnLocked: The MRN cannot be changed once assigned.
patient.notesHint: Administrative notes only. Clinical observations belong in a session.
patient.preferredLanguageHint: Reports for this patient default to this language.

chart.noSessionsBody: Complete the intake, then start the first scan.
chart.recurringSub: Found in more than one session
chart.noRecurring: No pair has been found in more than one session.
chart.noTrend: Trends appear after the first signed session.
chart.noIntakeBody: An intake with contraindication screening is required before the first scan.
chart.summaryOnly: Summary only — clinical detail is limited to practitioners.
chart.noReportsBody: Reports appear here once a session is finalized and signed.

intake.techniqueP1: Biomagnetic Pair therapy places pairs of magnets of opposite polarity on specific points of the body. The practitioner identifies pairs in resonance through a scan and applies the magnets for a short period.
intake.techniqueP2: It is a complementary practice. Findings are reported as “related to” a pathogen or condition — never as a diagnosis — and do not replace evaluation or treatment by a licensed physician.
intake.explained: The technique, its scope and its limitations were explained to the patient.
intake.questions: The patient had the opportunity to ask questions and they were answered.

q.understandsScope: Does the patient understand that biomagnetism is complementary and does not replace medical care?
q.continuesMedical: Will the patient continue all current medical indications and treatments?
q.authorizesPlacement: Does the patient authorize the placement of magnets on the body (over clothing when possible)?
q.followUpInformed: Was the patient informed that a follow-up scan is recommended after one week?

intake.absoluteHint: Any absolute contraindication blocks starting a scan.
intake.relativeHint: Proceed only with clinical judgement; these are shown as warnings during the scan.
intake.absBlockBody: With an absolute contraindication recorded, a biomagnetic scan must not be started for this patient.
intake.signatureName: Full name of patient or legal guardian
intake.signatureHint: Typed as the electronic signature of the authorization.
intake.signAck: The patient (or legal guardian) read and signed the authorization for treatment.
intake.savedBlocked: An absolute contraindication was recorded — scanning is blocked for this patient.
intake.savedRelative: Relative contraindications recorded — they will be shown during the scan.
intake.previous: Last intake recorded {date}, signed by {name}. Saving creates a new, dated record; earlier records are kept.

scanStart.title: New scan — {name}
scanStart.protocolsHint: Optional — you can add or remove protocols during the scan.
scanStart.noProtocols: No protocols selected — you can run a free or directed scan.
scanStart.chiefPlaceholder: What brings the patient in today?

relativeBody.one: 1 relative contraindication is recorded. Proceed with clinical judgement.
relativeBody.other: {count} relative contraindications are recorded. Proceed with clinical judgement.

scanStart.blockedBody: {name}’s latest intake records an absolute contraindication. A biomagnetic scan must not be started.
scanStart.blockedHint: Recorded in the intake of {date}. If this has changed, record a new intake first.
scanStart.noIntakeBody: Record the intake, contraindication screening and signed authorization before the first scan.
scanStart.consentRequired: An intake consent must be recorded before starting a session.

scan.title: Scan
scan.protocolAlready: That protocol is already in the checklist
scan.checklistEmptyBody: Add a protocol above, or use the Directed tab to suggest pairs from symptoms.
scan.directedIntro: Choose the symptoms the patient reports. Pairs are ranked by how many symptoms they relate to and how often they are found.
scan.freeTextPlaceholder: Free text, e.g. heavy legs in the evening
scan.suggestNeedInput: Add at least one symptom or some details first.
scan.noPairsAtPoint: No catalog pair uses this point.
scan.chiefPlaceholder: What brings the patient in today?
scan.noFindingsBody: Mark pairs as found from the checklist, the body map, or with the F key.
scan.timerDone: Dwell time complete — {pair}. Re-check the pair.
scan.followUpHint: Recommended one week after the session (reservoir release).
scan.relativeTip: Relative contraindications are recorded in the intake — proceed with clinical judgement.
scan.lockedBody: Finalized sessions are read-only. To correct it, create an amendment — the original stays on record.
scan.supersededBody: A newer revision of this session exists. This one is kept for the record and is read-only.
scan.noPermissionBody: Your role can view this session but cannot record findings.
scan.lockedElsewhere: This session was finalized or changed elsewhere — reloading the latest version.
scan.amendHint: Recorded on the new revision and in the audit log.
scan.amendExisting: An amendment draft already exists — opening it.
scan.amendSuperseded: This revision was already amended — opening the latest.
scan.finalizeNoFindings: No findings were recorded. You can still sign a session with no findings.
scan.attestation: I attest that I personally performed this scan and that these findings are complementary, non-diagnostic observations recorded accurately.
scan.signatureMismatch: Type your name exactly as it appears on your account: {name}
scan.finalizeLock: After signing, the report is sealed with a SHA-256 fingerprint and can only be changed through an amendment.
scan.cannotFinalizeUnsaved: Some changes could not be saved yet. Check your connection and try again.
scan.unsavedBody: Some changes have not reached the server yet. If you leave now they may be lost.
scan.kNotPresent: Mark not present and move on
scan.signatureFixed: Your account name is used as the electronic signature.
scan.reauthHint: Re-entering your password confirms that you are the one signing.
scan.signatureServerMismatch: The signature must match the signed-in practitioner’s name.
scan.reportLanguageHint: Defaults to the patient's preferred language. The signed report records this language.

viewer.fallbackNote: 3D model unavailable — showing the 2D body map.
viewer.missingAnatomy: {n} points have no body position yet; find them in the point list.

pair.ratingsLegend: F = how often it is found · P = pathogenicity · R = ease of resolution (1–3)
pair.seeAlsoHint: Other pairs placed on the same points.

catalog.title: Reference
catalog.subtitle: The biomagnetic pair catalog: pairs, related entities, protocols, symptoms and contraindications.
catalog.ordinal: Order of relation in the source
catalog.pickProtocol: Choose a protocol to see its ordered pairs
catalog.cardSub: Printable card with front and back body maps — prints on Letter landscape.
catalog.cardImgAlt: {view} body map for {name} with magnet placements
catalog.importantBody: Follow medical indications. Visit your physician and biomagnetist.

report.title: Biomagnetic Pair Scan Report
report.noFindings: No pairs were found in resonance during this session.
report.legend: Findings are complementary observations “related to” the listed entities — never a diagnosis. F/P/R: frequency, pathogenicity, resolution (1–3). Sides: R right, L left; qualifiers: S superior, Inf inferior, A anterior, P posterior, Lat lateral.
report.mapAlt: {view} body map with numbered magnet placements
report.followUpNote: A follow-up scan is recommended after one week.
report.attestationText: I attest that this report accurately reflects the findings of the session described above.
report.disclaimer: Biomagnetic Pair findings are complementary, non-diagnostic observations. They do not identify disease and do not replace evaluation, diagnosis or treatment by a licensed physician. Continue all medical indications.
report.draftBody: It is not signed and may still change. Finalize the session to produce the signed report.
report.supersededBanner: Amended — this revision has been superseded by a newer report.
report.integrityMismatch: Integrity check failed: the stored report does not match its sealed fingerprint. Contact your administrator.
report.imagesNotSaved: Body maps could not be stored with the report.
report.generalNote: Summaries of the general guidance — your practitioner can provide the full recommendation sheets.
report.auditorOnlyFinal: Auditors can open final and amended reports. This session has not been signed yet.
report.translationBody: The signed original is in {lang}. Only the original is covered by the signature and the integrity hash.

settings.reportFooterHint: Printed at the bottom of every report.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.banner: Your recovery codes use an older format. Regenerate them now.
recovery.regenBody: This creates 10 new single-use codes and immediately invalidates all of your old ones. Confirm with your password and a current authenticator code.
recovery.reauthFailed: The password or authentication code is not correct.
recovery.newCodesBody: Your old codes no longer work. Save these new codes now — they are shown only once.
recovery.regenerated: New recovery codes are active; the old ones no longer work.
recovery.hint: Use a recovery code to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. Regenerate them if you think they were exposed.

langpacks.intro: Spanish is the baseline catalog language. Every other language mirrors it entry by entry; when a Spanish text changes, its translation becomes stale until reviewed. Edits here take effect immediately.
langpacks.noMirrors: Only the baseline language pack is installed.
langpacks.searchPlaceholder: Search Spanish or translated text, or a key
langpacks.reviewSub: Stale and missing entries fall back to the Spanish original with an ES badge until translated.
langpacks.revertBody: Your edit is removed and the text shipped in the language pack is used again.
langpacks.staleHint: The Spanish original changed since this was translated. Check it and save to mark it reviewed.
